section.devices.help: Keep the selected device and quick switcher visible. Device details show status, battery, network, ID and pairing; this sets whether they start expanded.
section.actions.help: Show selected device shortcuts and their Ping or Text composer together. Hiding shortcuts does not change native modules.
section.drop.help: Choose local files to send, or drop files for review. Enable Review files before Send to review chooser selections. Hiding this section preserves the draft.
section.native.help: Show native feature links in Devices. The full inventory stays available in Device features settings.
section.media.help: Show reported players and media controls. Hiding this section does not stop playback.
section.commands.help: Show commands configured on the selected device. A command runs only after an explicit request.
section.connections.help: Show enabled VPN tool controls. Hiding or collapsing them does not connect or disconnect a VPN.
section.addresses.help: Keep approved addresses available for review. Hiding this section preserves saved records and rediscovery choices.
section.syncthing.help: Show the optional local identity note and existing owner controls. Hiding it does not change Syncthing.
